question: Is the positive association between current external isolation and C-minus-R3 merely a restatement of blocks having more graph-source-empty cells?

raw: partial Spearman rho(x,y | z) using the three rank correlations
within_bioregion: center x,y,z by their bioregion arithmetic means
compute the same three Spearman correlations on centered values
compute partial Spearman rho(centered x, centered y | centered z)

interpretation.if_partial_collapses_toward_zero: external-isolation attenuation is largely redundant with graph-source emptiness
interpretation.if_partial_remains_close_to_unadjusted: external-isolation attenuation is not explained by graph-source emptiness alone

anti_fishing: only Current_isolation and graph_empty_fraction are tested in this audit
no additional covariate search is authorized
no block, bioregion or species is removed
the frozen v1.76 primary and all v1.85 claim boundaries remain unchanged
